verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a hosted MCP service, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Related items cover different capabilities and earn no credit: revoking connected-account access, encrypting credentials at rest, and Conduit's observability for IT teams.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
